tutorial.title: How to use KaadoNeuro
tutorial.intro: KaadoNeuro uses SM-2 spaced repetition to lock in memory with minimal effort. No childish gamification. Just focus, calm and precision.
tutorial.step1a: On the home screen, click New deck. Give it a short name, for example: English, Programming or History.
tutorial.step1b: Inside the deck, add cards with a Front (question) and a Back (answer).
tutorial.step2Body: For many cards at once, use Import in the deck. Two options:
tutorial.viaTextHint: Paste from a notes app or ChatGPT. Separate with "---".
tutorial.viaFileHint: Load .json, .md, .txt or an Anki .apkg. In JSON, use an array with front and back fields. You get a preview and progress bar before saving.
tutorial.step3Body: The app shows the front; try to recall. Tap Show answer and rate:
